courses.course_name: Bachelor of Management Accounting
courses.course_description:
The Bachelor of Science in Management Accounting (BSMA) is a degree program focused on the use of accounting and financial information to support internal business management and decision-making. Students learn how to prepare, analyze, and interpret financial and operational information that can help organizations plan, control operations, manage costs, evaluate performance, and make informed business decisions.
The program covers management accounting, financial accounting, cost accounting, budgeting, financial analysis, taxation, auditing, accounting information systems, and other business-related areas. Unlike programs focused primarily on external financial reporting and public accountancy, management accounting emphasizes the use of accounting information for planning, internal decision-making, performance evaluation, and organizational management .

courses.course_description: The Bachelor of Science in Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering (BSABE) is an engineering degree that applies engineering science and design to agricultural, biological, environmental, and natural-resource systems. The Land and Water Resources Engineering specialization focuses on the engineering planning, development, conservation, and management of land and water resources. Important applications include irrigation and drainage, soil and water conservation, land development, hydrology/agrometeorology, water-resource systems, dams, farm roads and bridges, and related agricultural and environmental infrastructure. Official university program descriptions identify land development, irrigation and drainage, soil and water resources, environmental management, and related infrastructure as major areas of BSABE practice. The specialization is also directly represented in the Philippine Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering profession. Republic Act No. 10915 identifies Land and Water Resources Engineering as one of the competency areas covered by the Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering licensure examination.
